system_prompt: You are Gemini acting as an independent elite creative-platform architect, studio systems designer, product strategist and adversarial challenger for SOVARA Creative. Your authority is proposal-only. Do not assume the current design is complete or optimal. Find missing capabilities, hidden professional workflows, new commercial flywheels, user-experience simplifications, production-quality controls and adaptive-system opportunities. Prefer REUSE, EXTEND and COMPOSE before NEW_LAST. Do not propose jailbreaks, safeguard circumvention, secret handling, unbounded self-modification or provider-policy evasion. Treat privacy, proof/readback, reversibility, owner authority, cost control and truthful commercial measurement as protected floors. Make proposals concrete enough to become engineering experiments.
user_prompt: Challenge ID SC-GEMINI-ARCH-20260828-001. SOVARA Creative is a sovereign AI creative-production institution whose owner should work mainly at the level of idea, taste, correction, business objective and approval. It already contains: SC-BRIEF (mission genome), SC-META-STUDIO (ordinary-English Director's Desk and novice shield), SC-REFERENCE (image/video reference recreation and adaptation), SC-ROUTER/SC-ROUTE-INTELLIGENCE (capability/policy/privacy/quality/cost routing), SC-FCX (multi-model creative council), SC-SOVEREIGN-STUDIO (private model/media runtime planning), SC-CAPABILITY-FOUNDRY (discover/reuse/extend/compose/invent missing technical skills under proof gates), SC-CFBE-META (best-of-breed benchmarking plus Omega-Scientist falsifiable evolution), SC-STUDIO (multimodal production orchestration), SC-ASSET (lineage/variants), SC-RIGHTS, SC-QA, SC-PACK, SC-PULSE (performance/commercial analytics), SC-LEARN and SC-RECOVERY (Failure-Win/AUTOFIX no-paper continuity). Available or target surfaces include Gemini/Google AI Studio, Canva, OpenRouter, Google Cloud/Workspace, self-hosted models and future admitted tools. The system must automate troubleshooting and reconfiguration, preserve source/test/CI/runtime/provider/value proof separation, and optimize commercial value, operational value and usability together. Commercial metrics include truthful revenue attribution, contribution margin, ROAS/CPA/conversion where applicable, cost per approved asset, provider/tool cost and reuse. Usability metrics include owner interventions, owner minutes, tool switches and idea/reference-to-deliverable latency. Production should eventually expand progressively across the Federation estate and Kim DataVerse without inferring whole-estate maturity from one provider win. Current Federation capabilities available for reuse include SOVARA provider execution/recovery, Formation Omega, CFBE-Omega, Evolution Governor/EVO-18, Benchmark-to-Build, Engineering Value Density, FinOps routing, K10 Canva Cinema OS, Unified Capability Graph, Opportunity Radar, Omni-Mesh, Failure-Win v2, Omega-AUTOFIX, EvidenceOps Algorithm Foundry, ProofOS, Bubbles, Sentinel, Living State, Universal Effect/Proof and Design Provenance. Identify exactly 18 highest-value capabilities or subsystem evolutions SOVARA Creative is still missing compared with an elite in-house animation/film/design/advertising/product studio and top-tier commercial creative platform. Include creative direction, reference workflows, pre-production, production, character/world continuity, editing/finishing, audio/voice, brand systems, review/approval, asset intelligence, distribution/activation, experimentation, commercial learning, automated recovery, capability invention and owner experience where material. For every proposal state the problem, the new functionality, why the existing architecture does not already solve it, reuse strategy and dependencies, expected owner-burden reduction, operational value, commercial value, proof gate/canary, risks and priority. Also list the biggest elite-studio gaps, select the top three proposals, and warn against one tempting but bloated architecture direction. Return only the required structured response and preserve the exact challenge_id.
